title: TESTING.md cites test/source.properties.test.js which never existed
description: Round C closure audit: the TESTING.md omp-transfer row promises 'test/source.properties.test.js (fc.commands, fake clock): hung fetch times out, back-off, no stale overwrite' but git log --all on that path is empty - the citation was false when usage-s7 closed, and the gate only validated the traceability section's rows. The promised behaviors (hang -> timeout -> backoff; late exchange never replaces data even when a newer refresh applied) have no generated test anywhere.
acceptance_criteria: Red commit: test/traceability.test.js gains a check that every TESTING.md citation exists and fails on the dangling row; fix commit adds test/source.properties.test.js with real source-level properties and repairs the citation; suite green at NUM_RUNS=1000

title: Fast suites ignore NUM_RUNS (hard-coded numRuns)
description: Oct 11 audit finding 'hard-coded numRuns', recorded but never fixed: throttle.properties (numRuns 150/30/400), route.properties (150), plus tui.host (HOST_RUNS default 150) and oracle.cmux (CMUX_RUNS default 60) never derive from NUM_RUNS. The release gate runs fast suites at NUM_RUNS=1000; that must be real for every fast property, not just the files routed through test/support/fc.js.
acceptance_criteria: Red commit: test/budget.test.js fails on the hard-coded literals and non-NUM_RUNS env defaults; fix commit turns every fast property into a NUM_RUNS-derived budget (fcOpts cost/floor); full fast suite green at NUM_RUNS=1000 afterwards; TESTING.md budgets describe the actual contract

title: U13: legacy Anthropic utilization <=1 read as a fraction (0.9 shows 90%, 1.0 shows 1%)
description: lib/normalize.js toPercent(fractions:true) scales a non-integer utilization <= 1 by 100. ProviderProxy's payload shows utilization is a percentage (five_hour.utilization 8 beside limits[].percent 8). Non-monotone: 0.015 -> 2% but 1 -> 1%.
acceptance_criteria: test/normalize.properties.test.js (U13) red commit then fix commit; full suite green
close_reason: Record correction (round C closure audit, 2026-10-12): the earlier close_reason cited fix 728c570, a duplicate dropped in the round-1 rebase and not on main. The landed fix on main is 506fd48 ('fix: Anthropic legacy utilization is a percentage (U13, usage-b1)'), red is 0dc5019; toPercent's fraction scaling is gone in committed lib/normalize.js and the U13 normalize + route properties pass at NUM_RUNS=1000 (dsh 0.2.1-alpha.2). No code change; evidence reference corrected.

title: Release procedure: RELEASING.md + CHANGELOG.md, cut release in round 3
description: RELEASING.md per skill references/release.md (SemVer, alpha channel matching DSH, exact peer pins, CHANGELOG, annotated tag vX.Y.Z[-alpha.N]); in round 3 cut a release if all required suites green.
acceptance_criteria: RELEASING.md and CHANGELOG.md committed; round 3: annotated tag pushed with evidence in CHANGELOG.

title: Bugs red/fix and mutation campaign
description: Red commit then fix commit per bug; deliberate mutants (incl. abort-listener cleanup, reset boundary) against new tests; record caught N/N in TESTING.md.
acceptance_criteria: Each bug bead has red sha + fix sha; mutation table caught N/N in TESTING.md.
close_reason: mutants M7 (abort-listener cleanup removed in lib/source.js) killed by new test/source.leak.test.js (settled + timed-out report leave zero listeners) and M8 (reset boundary <= -> < in lib/report.js) killed by tui.host U6 boundary; planted one at a time, lib/ restored byte-identical; caught 8/8 cumulative in TESTING.md

title: TESTING.md traceability table
description: Table property ID -> test file/name -> surface -> last result with seed, run count, DSH versions; every SPEC property maps to >=1 test; no required test silently skips.
acceptance_criteria: Every SPEC ID appears in table with a test; a check script fails if one is missing; skips are explicit failures for required suites.
notes: REOPEN 2026-10-12 (round C closure audit): TESTING.md's omp-transfer table cites test/source.properties.test.js, which git history shows never existed; the citation-gate covered only the traceability section's rows, so a false citation escaped. The promised U4/U5 behaviors have no test anywhere. Reopens to create the real file, fix the citation and widen the gate (usage-b3 red/fix), then re-run before re-closing.

acceptance_criteria: test/rig/* byte-equal to nix-config at recorded commit (plus SOURCE note); grep shows no ~/.agents import; rig-based suites pass.

title: flake.nix: package, devShell, checks, e2e app
description: packages.default (version from package.json), devShells.default (node, tmux, Nix Chromium for Playwright, beads, pinned dsh 0.2.1-alpha.2 from nix-dsh f0ca0d7 and dsh-TUI 0.14.0 + launchpad-status), checks running fast suites in sandbox, apps.e2e running real-client suites; inputs pinned by rev with flake.lock.
acceptance_criteria: nix flake check passes; nix develop provides node/tmux/chromium/bd/dsh/DSH_TUI_DIR; nix run .#e2e runs both real-client suites.
notes: REOPEN 2026-10-12 (round C closure audit): close evidence claims the fast suite ran at NUM_RUNS=1000, but throttle.properties (150/30/400), route.properties (150), tui.host (HOST_RUNS) and oracle.cmux (CMUX_RUNS) never read NUM_RUNS, so the claim held only for files routed through test/support/fc.js. The Oct 11 audit finding 'hard-coded numRuns' stayed unfixed. Reopens to make the budget honest (usage-b2 red/fix), then re-run npm test at NUM_RUNS=1000 + nix flake check before re-closing.
